description:
Title: Instruct an artist to create a 3D model print it on a 3D printer

When craving a custom 3D model, as a first step you have to instruct an artist to create a project for you.
First you have to send him several sketches, and then tell him what to change until you are satisfied with the result.
After that, you choose a plastic color you want to use for 3D printing.
If you have the color at home (in stock), you check how much color you have left.
If it's under 100 grams, you put it on your shopping list.
If you do not have the color at home, you order it.
When you have the plastic, you can turn the printer on and heat up the bed and the extruder (it continuously sends you back its status).
While doing that, you can generate the gcode file for your printer out of the STL sent to you by the artist.
After that you print the model.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_3DPrint" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/3dprint-custom-model">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Sketches" name="Sketches sent"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Draft" name="Project draft"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Changes" name="Requested changes"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Revision" name="Revised draft"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_STL" name="STL file"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_PlasticDelivered" name="Plastic delivered"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_PrinterStatus" name="Printer status update"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_3DPrint">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Artist" name="Artist"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Sketches" name="Sketches" sourceRef="Task_SendSketches" targetRef="Participant_Artist"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Draft" name="Project draft" sourceRef="Participant_Artist" targetRef="Catch_DraftReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Changes" name="Change requests" sourceRef="Task_SendChanges" targetRef="Participant_Artist"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Revision" name="Revised draft" sourceRef="Participant_Artist" targetRef="Catch_RevisionReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_STL" name="STL file" sourceRef="Participant_Artist" targetRef="ReceiveTask_STL"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Instruct an artist to create a 3D model and print it" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Craving" name="Craving a custom 3D model"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_InstructArtist" name="Instruct artist to create project"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendSketches" name="Send several sketches to artist" messageRef="Msg_Sketches"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_DraftReceived" name="Project draft received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Draft" messageRef="Msg_Draft"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Satisfied_Draft" name="Satisfied with draft?"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Changes_Merge" name="Changes requested"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendChanges" name="Tell artist what to change" messageRef="Msg_Changes"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_RevisionReceived" name="Revised draft received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Revision" messageRef="Msg_Revision"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Satisfied_Revision" name="Satisfied with revision?"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Result_Merge" name="Satisfied with result"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ChooseColor" name="Choose plastic color"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InStock_Split" name="Color in stock at home?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckAmount" name="Check remaining amount of color"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Under100_Split" name="Less than 100 g left?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AddToShoppingList" name="Add color to shopping list"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderColor" name="Order plastic color"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_PlasticDelivered" name="Plastic delivered">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_PlasticDelivered" messageRef="Msg_PlasticDelivered"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Plastic_Merge" name="Plastic available"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Parallel_Split" name="Prepare printing"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_HeatPrinter" name="Turn on printer and heat bed and extruder"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Receive_PrinterStatus" name="Receive printer status updates" messageRef="Msg_PrinterStatus">
      <bpmn:documentation>The printer continuously sends its status back while it is heating.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_StatusMonitored" name="Printer status received"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="ReceiveTask_STL" name="Receive STL file from artist" messageRef="Msg_STL"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GenerateGcode" name="Generate gcode file from STL"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Parallel_Join" name="Printer ready and gcode generated"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrintModel" name="Print model"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Printed" name="3D model printed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Craving" targetRef="Task_InstructArtist"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_InstructArtist" targetRef="Task_SendSketches"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_SendSketches" targetRef="Catch_DraftReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Catch_DraftReceived" targetRef="Gateway_Satisfied_Draft"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Satisfied_Draft" targetRef="Gateway_Result_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Satisfied_Draft" targetRef="Gateway_Changes_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Gateway_Changes_Merge" targetRef="Task_SendChanges"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Task_SendChanges" targetRef="Catch_RevisionReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Catch_RevisionReceived" targetRef="Gateway_Satisfied_Revision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Satisfied_Revision" targetRef="Gateway_Result_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Satisfied_Revision" targetRef="Gateway_Changes_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Gateway_Result_Merge" targetRef="Task_ChooseColor"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_ChooseColor" targetRef="Gateway_InStock_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_InStock_Split" targetRef="Task_CheckAmount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_InStock_Split" targetRef="Task_OrderColor"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Task_CheckAmount" targetRef="Gateway_Under100_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Under100_Split" targetRef="Task_AddToShoppingList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Under100_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Plastic_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Task_AddToShoppingList" targetRef="Gateway_Plastic_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="Task_OrderColor" targetRef="Catch_PlasticDelivered"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="Catch_PlasticDelivered" targetRef="Gateway_Plastic_Merge"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_22" sourceRef="Gateway_Plastic_Merge" targetRef="Gateway_Parallel_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_23" sourceRef="Gateway_Parallel_Split" targetRef="Task_HeatPrinter"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_24" sourceRef="Gateway_Parallel_Split" targetRef="Receive_PrinterStatus"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_25" sourceRef="Gateway_Parallel_Split" targetRef="ReceiveTask_STL"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_26" sourceRef="Receive_PrinterStatus" targetRef="EndEvent_StatusMonitored"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_27" sourceRef="ReceiveTask_STL" targetRef="Task_GenerateGcode"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_28" sourceRef="Task_HeatPrinter" targetRef="Gateway_Parallel_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_29" sourceRef="Task_GenerateGcode" targetRef="Gateway_Parallel_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_30" sourceRef="Gateway_Parallel_Join" targetRef="Task_PrintModel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_31" sourceRef="Task_PrintModel" targetRef="EndEvent_Printed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
